STEP 7 - Energy: Minced meat dumplings/meatballs, cooked, typically ~220–250 kcal/100 g (pork/mixed meat with some binder). Using 230 kcal/100 g: 35 g × 2.3 = ~81 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Four small meatballs on a side plate covering ~15% of the plate; 35 g total and ~80 kcal is plausible for a light appetizer portion and is not inflated by a typical serving.

Total: about 35 g, about 80 kcal.
